text:
sasha: Partner Q surfaced a weird billing gap: they replayed hourly batches after a network partition and our reconciler accepted duplicates for 2 hours. Need a quick plan to avoid customer-facing credits.
mark: How big is the delta?
sasha: ~9k embedding units + 40k tokens across 2 SKUs, mostly EU region, burst around 04:10 UTC.
samir: short fix: treat any batch with header `X-Partner-Replay: 1` or server-detected replay as `replay_pending` and route to replay-review topic. Don't convert to credit until match confirmed.
billing: Agree. Show `replay_pending` on invoices with clear note; convert to credit only after reconciler match.
jen: Legal asks that any replay event includes `signed_fingerprint` and `original_event_id`. Otherwise require partner attestation.
samir: I'll add ingest flag + topic routing and a metric `replay_pending_count`. Can push a canary tonight for partner Q.
ingest-bot: deploy planned: ingest-service:v2.14.5 canary us-east-1 -> feature flag partner.replay_pending.Q = on.
sasha: Action items: samir implement (ETA 24h), mark to coordinate partner test (ETA 48h), billing/jen to draft invoice/legal language (ETA 72h).
mark: Also add alert if replay_pending_count > 5k for >10m.
sasha: thanks all, we'll reconvene after staging run.
